messages:
aaron: heads-up — canary run for kernel-selector v2.4.0 rolled out to mixtral/qwen pools. latency improved ~10% but we see quality drift on long-context evals (mixtral-30k prompt).

maria: details? which kernel path swapped and what changed in RoPE/quant?

aaron: looks like attention-path switched from `tiled_attn_fast` -> `hybrid_attn_v2` for mixtral and qwen when sequence > 4096. also we enabled 'rope_scale: auto_bias' in the selector. quant unchanged in canary (still int8 fallback).

kevin: any perf traces or kv cache metrics?

aaron: pasting profiling snippet from the canary node (hot-path):

```
# perf-summary
kernel: hybrid_attn_v2
lat_p50: 78ms -> 70ms ( -10.3% )
kv-miss-rate: 0.02 -> 0.16
kv-cache-allocs/sec: 120 -> 210
head-drop-count: 0 -> 12
ppl_longseq_eval: 11.2 -> 11.6 (+3.6%)
regression_examples: hallucination on content span tokens ~@token1000
```

maria: kv-miss-rate jumping like that is suspicious — might be a layout or head/kv dim mismatch. which mixtral variant? mixtral-8x7b?

aaron: mixtral-8x7b-qlora compiled with kernel-profiles for head_dim=64, kv-dim=64. qwen-7b-psi also hit similar delta.

jen: could rope_scale:auto_bias be rescaling positional embedding slightly causing phase shift on long contexts? we saw tiny shifts before when switching tiled->merged kernels.

kevin: +1. also note hybrid_attn_v2 uses a tiled packing optimization that assumes contiguous KV layout. if our KV eviction/eviction-compact changed, that could cause logical misalignment on multihead slicing.

aaron: added small repro with deterministic seed on canary — running eval harness now: `./eval_harness --model mixtral-8x7b --seq 32768 --prompts ./longset.json --kernel=hybrid_attn_v2`

perf-bot: eval job 2140001245 started (canary-2). logs: https://internal.ci/eval/2140001245

maria: can you paste a short stack/log where the head-drop shows? even a hexdump of KV header would help.

aaron: here's snippet from runtime debug (truncated):

```
KV_PAGE_HEADER { version: 2, stride: 512, head_dim: 64, kv_layout: "row-major" }
KV_PAGE_DATA[0..16]: 0x7f8a3b00 0x00000040 0x00000040 0x01
slice_map: [0,64,128,192,...]
```

jen: hmm header looks ok. but if hybrid_attn_v2 expects column-major for packed KV we get head offsets swapped -> head dropout artifacts. did selector change kernel metadata mapping?

aaron: yes — selector now maps model.meta.kv_layout -> kernel.param.kv_layout with a fallback, but the fallback preferred column-major for speed. I think for mixtral the compiled kernels were still row-major.

kevin: that would explain simultaneous latency wins (fast path used) and quality drift (wrong layout). simple mismatch.

maria: what's the mitigation? revert the selector change to enforce explicit kv_layout mapping per model until we can add asserts in kernel init.

aaron: I can push a rollback to selector config. but we should also run a quick diff patch that adds an assert in kernel init to verify `expected_stride == actual_stride` to catch this in CI.

jen: agree. also add a small unit test that runs a 8-head, 64-dim synthetic KV through both tiled_attn_fast and hybrid_attn_v2 and compares outputs at low temp.

kevin: question: should we rollback production canary immediately or patch canary? how many customers hit this canary pool?

aaron: canary is <1% traffic but internal evals flagged real-world chat regressions. ops suggests rollback until we have a patch.

deploy-bot: rollback request submitted for kernel-selector v2.3.1 -> v2.4.0 canary (job 2140001299). status: queued.

maria: create follow-up ticket for: selector metadata mapping, kernel init asserts, unit test, and add a perf/regression eval job. tag kevin+jen.

aaron: opening ticket: RW-ENG-5123 with reproducer and logs, assigning kevin/jen. putting notes on impact & rollback.

kevin: I'll take kernel-init assert + unit test. jen you want selector fix + mapping table?

jen: yep. I'll also add a canary gate that runs the long-context eval subset before flipping the selector.

aaron: thanks. after rollback we'll run the eval harness across mixtral/qwen variants with both tiled_attn_fast & hybrid_attn_v2 to confirm parity.

maria: decision: rollback now, no hotfix to prod until parity tests pass. postmortem if customer-facing regressions observed. :warning:

aaron: noted. updating the canary thread and RW-ENG-5123 with steps. will follow up once CI test green.

perf-bot: rollback completed: 2140001299 -> success. canary nodes back to kernel-selector v2.3.1.

jen: thanks all — good catch. we'll aim to get a non-regressing hybrid path with explicit layout negotiation within 48h.

kevin: adding a profiling job to run nightly for next 3 days to watch kv-miss-rate and head-drop histograms.

aaron: closing loop here, will paste CI diffs and failing eval samples into RW-ENG-5123.

maria: rough timeline: rollback done, ticket created, patches assigned. we should be good. :thumbsup:
